text.diplomatic: Lord, unto us be merciful,
text.normalized: Lord, unto us be merciful,
text.reading: Lord, unto us be merciful,

text.diplomatic: do thou us also bless;
text.normalized: Do thou us also bless;
text.reading: do thou us also bless;

text.diplomatic: And graciously cause shine on us
text.normalized: And graciously cause shine on us
text.reading: And graciously cause shine on us

text.diplomatic: the brightness of thy face:
text.normalized: The brightness of thy face:
text.reading: the brightness of thy face:

text.diplomatic: That so thy way upon the earth
text.normalized: That so thy way upon the earth
text.reading: That so thy way upon the earth

text.diplomatic: to all men may be known;
text.normalized: To all men may be known;
text.reading: to all men may be known;

text.diplomatic: Also among the nations all
text.normalized: Also among the nations all
text.reading: Also among the nations all

text.diplomatic: thy saving health be shown.
text.normalized: Thy saving health be shown.
text.reading: thy saving health be shown.

text.diplomatic: O let the people praise thee, Lord;
text.normalized: O let the people praise thee, Lord;
text.reading: O let the people praise thee, Lord;

text.diplomatic: let people all thee praise.
text.normalized: Let people all thee praise.
text.reading: let people all thee praise.

text.diplomatic: O let the nätions be glad,
text.normalized: O let the nätions be glad,
text.reading: O let the nätions be glad,

text.diplomatic: and sing for joy always:
text.normalized: And sing for joy always:
text.reading: and sing for joy always:

text.diplomatic: For rightly thou shalt people judge,
text.normalized: For rightly thou shalt people judge,
text.reading: For rightly thou shalt people judge,

text.diplomatic: and nations rule on earth.
text.normalized: And nations rule on earth.
text.reading: and nations rule on earth.

text.diplomatic: Let people praise thee, Lord; let all
text.normalized: Let people praise thee, Lord; let all
text.reading: Let people praise thee, Lord; let all

text.diplomatic: the folk praise thee with mirth.
text.normalized: The folk praise thee with mirth.
text.reading: the folk praise thee with mirth.

text.diplomatic: Then shall the earth yield her increase;
text.normalized: Then shall the earth yield her increase;
text.reading: Then shall the earth yield her increase;

text.diplomatic: God, our God, bless us shall.
text.normalized: God, our God, bless us shall.
text.reading: God, our God, bless us shall.

text.diplomatic: God shall us bless; and of the earth
text.normalized: God shall us bless; and of the earth
text.reading: God shall us bless; and of the earth

text.diplomatic: the ends shall fear him all.
text.normalized: The ends shall fear him all.
text.reading: the ends shall fear him all.
